description: Fetch one capability's operations, prices and how to call it, by the slug returned from search_caps. Call this before using a cap: it lists each operation (by name), its input and output schema when the developer provided one, which routes are billable, the per-call maximum, when the call settles, and the error codes the caller may see. If the request carries the user's Qumge key, it also reports that user's monthly limit for this cap. (Older clients may still call this tool as get_app — it still works.)

qumge_key.description: Optional: your Qumge API key, for clients that cannot set an Authorization header. Takes precedence over the header. Never echoed back.

slug.description: The cap's slug, e.g. 'autowhisper'. Comes from search_caps.

name: get_cap

free_calls.description: First N calls per user are free (accounts that have topped up; failed calls don't count).

meter.description: "platform" means Qumge counts one unit per successful (2xx) call at the unit price — a failing call is free.
